items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: So we played together in Plymouth at the art museum or the art school, something like that. Mike Westbrook played there too at that time.

ctx.x: He played a mean baritone sax, didn’t he? © Fillius Jazz Archive -4-

He did. Even then, he was 16 and we connected, the first time it was not in Southampton, Plymouth. So we played together in Plymouth at the art museum or the art school, something like that. Mike Westbrook played there too at that time.
What kind of jazz first appealed to you?
